items.title: Scaffold + frozen Layer 1 contract (Vite app, core types, data schema, token CSS)
items.acceptance: Dev server boots a page titled Prompt Spark with the token palette applied, and the frozen contract modules (PRNG/hash signatures, DIFFICULTY_TO_TIME map with easy='1–2 hours'/medium='an evening or two (3–6 hours)'/hard='a weekend+ (10+ hours)', LADDER_RUNGS tuple Weekend/Week/Month/Moonshot, Template/Prompt shapes, pack entry schema with twist pools, CSS class vocabulary prompt-card/ladder-rung/remix-card/fav-item) typecheck cleanly.
items.notes: Layer 1 is frozen after this item ships — no other item may edit these files. All Vitest/jsdom devDeps land here so no later item touches package.json.

items.title: Real Estate + Law subject packs (10+ templates each)
items.acceptance: Each of the two packs exports >=10 schema-conformant templates, every template has fill-in variable slots, a twist pool, and difficulty metadata, with all three difficulty tiers represented in each pack.
items.notes: Conform strictly to src/data/schema.ts. Runs in parallel with T-003.

items.title: Finance + Science subject packs (10+ templates each)
items.acceptance: Each of the two packs exports >=10 schema-conformant templates, every template has fill-in variable slots, a twist pool, and difficulty metadata, with all three difficulty tiers represented in each pack.
items.notes: Conform strictly to src/data/schema.ts. Runs in parallel with T-002.

items.title: Pack registry + per-subject lens lists + pack validity tests
items.acceptance: A single registry exposes all four packs plus per-subject lens lists, and tests pin >=10 templates per pack, non-empty template sets for every subject x difficulty combo, and schema validity of every entry.
items.notes: Tests ship with the module per project convention.

items.title: Deterministic core: mulberry32/djb2 RNG + generate(seed, filters) with tests
items.acceptance: generate(seed, filters) is pure and string-identical for identical seed+filters, always includes a twist, honors conjunctive subject AND difficulty filtering for every subject x difficulty combo (empty filters = all), and emits the fixed difficulty-to-time labels.
items.notes: Implements the exact signatures frozen in src/core/types.ts; exposes djb2 hash used for prompt ids hash(seed+templateId).

items.title: Brain Scout core: 4-rung ladder + 3 remixes with tests
items.acceptance: For any seed phrase, output is exactly 4 rungs in Weekend/Week/Month/Moonshot order each containing the seed phrase verbatim (tests cover mixed-case multi-word and punctuation-heavy seeds), plus exactly 3 remixes with distinct subject lenses, with ids hash('scout:'+seedPhrase+rung-or-lens-label).
items.notes: Uses rng/hash from T-005 and lens lists from src/data/index.ts.

items.title: Favorites store on localStorage with dedupe/remove-one semantics + jsdom tests
items.acceptance: Favorites persist under key prompt-spark:favorites:v1 across reload; adding an already-saved id is a no-op (deduped by id) and remove deletes exactly one entry.
items.notes: Single shared save path used later by both prompt cards and Brain Scout items; framework-agnostic module with a React subscription hook.

items.title: Share-link core: URL param encode/decode with roundtrip tests
items.acceptance: Encoding any seed+filters state to URL params and decoding it back yields an identical state (roundtrip equality), including empty-filter and all-filter cases.
items.notes: Pure module, no DOM; UI bootstrap wiring is deferred to T-013.

items.title: App shell: tab navigation, FilterBar, mobile-first app.css, compiling view stubs
items.acceptance: The app renders with working subject AND difficulty filter chips (conjunctive, empty = all) and navigable Generator/Brain Scout/Favorites sections at 375px width with the hero button as the visually largest element.
items.notes: Creates SurpriseHero/PromptCard/BrainScoutView/FavoritesView as minimal typed stubs so the app compiles; later items own those files exclusively and this item's files are not touched again in parallel waves.

items.title: SurpriseHero + PromptCard: generate, copy, save, seed-as-serial display
items.acceptance: Clicking Surprise me renders a prompt card (class prompt-card) showing the serial (e.g. 'No A4F2') whose Copy button puts the full prompt text on the clipboard and whose Save button adds it to favorites by id hash(seed+templateId).
items.notes: Surprise me draws a fresh random seed then calls the pure generate; card is a pure render of the Prompt shape.

items.title: BrainScoutView: seed phrase input, ladder rungs, remixes, copy/save
items.acceptance: Entering a seed phrase renders 4 ladder-rung cards in Weekend/Week/Month/Moonshot order and 3 remix-cards, each with working copy and save controls that persist through the shared favorites store.
items.notes: Uses frozen classes ladder-rung and remix-card; scout ids come from brainScout core, not recomputed in UI.

items.title: FavoritesView: list, copy, remove-one, empty state
items.acceptance: Saved prompts and scout items appear as fav-item entries after a page reload, each with a copy button and a remove button that deletes exactly that one entry.
items.notes: Pure consumer of the favorites store subscription hook.

items.title: Share-link URL bootstrap wiring
items.acceptance: Opening a URL containing share params renders the string-identical prompt (same seed+filters) that was showing when the share link was created, and each generated prompt exposes a copyable share link.
items.notes: Delighter; only starts after must-haves T-001..T-012 are verified. Sole owner of App.tsx in this wave.

items.title: ConfettiBurst + StatsBadge ('sparked today' streak)
items.acceptance: Generating a prompt fires a confetti burst (suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion) and increments a visible 'sparked today' streak badge.
items.notes: Confetti styles live inside the components (no app.css edits) to stay disjoint from T-015 in the same wave; streak stored under a separate localStorage key, never touching prompt-spark:favorites:v1.

items.title: Dark mode + favorites markdown export
items.acceptance: The app follows prefers-color-scheme dark using token values without visual regressions, and an Export button in Favorites downloads a markdown file listing every saved item.
items.notes: Dark values already exist as custom properties in frozen tokens.css; app.css only switches which tokens apply. markdown.ts is pure and unit-testable inline with this item.

items.title: Integration ship gate: full suite green + must-have smoke pass + README
items.acceptance: From a clean install and production build, every spec must-have (determinism, pack sizes, conjunctive filtering, clipboard, favorites persistence semantics, Brain Scout rung/remix contract) is demonstrably working end to end with the entire test suite passing.
items.notes: Only item allowed to add cross-module integration tests; also writes user-facing README with feature tour. Fix-forward any gaps found here as part of this item if trivial, otherwise file fixes.

items.title: Scope FilterBar to Generator view only
items.acceptance: Filter chips appear only on the Generator tab; Brain Scout and Favorites tabs show no FilterBar.
items.notes: cycle-6 look finding (low): App.tsx renders FilterBar outside the view conditional; filters are functionless on Scout/Favorites tabs
